name: @omadia/embedding-adapter-openai
description: OpenAI-compatible embedding adapter for omadia. Wraps POST /v1/embeddings (OpenAI, Azure via gateway, vLLM, LM Studio, LiteLLM) and provides the 'embeddingClient@1' capability, as an alternative to the Ollama adapter in @omadia/embeddings. API key is vault-backed, never plugin config.
